definition: the way a person acts in front of others
description: A quiet library reading room is seen through a doorway framed by bookshelves, and the view moves into the room. A young woman with long curly dark hair, in a beige knitted top and trousers, rides a wooden book trolley down the aisle with her arms flung up, shouting with joy, while books lie scattered on the herringbone floor. Students at long desks with green lamps turn and stare at her, and a man in a suit appears behind her. A sign asking for silence hangs in front of tall shelves.

en.question: What is the curly-haired woman doing?

de.question: Was macht die Frau mit den Locken?

es.answer: Va montada en un carrito de libros.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer de pelo rizado?

fr.answer: Elle roule sur un chariot à livres.
fr.question: Que fait la femme aux cheveux bouclés ?
